confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Zadar and the Dalmatian coast for July peak season; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals, wine) are more reliable than accommodation, where July rates vary widely by location, season and availability. Cocktail and wine are estimated from typical Croatian restaurant pricing relative to beer. Euro-to-USD conversion uses an assumed rate of roughly 1.16, so all USD figures carry some FX uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on other mid-sized Dalmatian coastal tourist towns in Croatia (such as Split and Šibenik) at summer peak pricing. Euro-area prices with a strong seasonal premium in July.
